notes.title: Patch notes and news
notes.notes:
Hello!
With this update I finally fixed a critical bug where the game would start in "1st person", quite zoomed in and with the rotor out of place. In other news, I'm currently doing finishing touches on a spiritual sequel to Deity Driving! I plan to release it in October.

notes.title: Final update
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

today I watched a stream by Japanese player Soshiki Hakase and that helped me find and fix more bugs!
Here's the video:
[previewyoutube=2IDt6FI3bis;full][/previewyoutube]
And here are the patch notes:
[list][*] Bigger player trigger in [i]Summer Simulator[/i] makes flowers easier to collect
[*] Phraser reactions at the frozen lake are different in a certain situation
[*] The cat says "thank you" after helping her
[*] Flying through the smoke rings triggers the smoke ring task
[*] Usage of the "flying higher" mod is clearer now
[*] Mouse usage tutorial in case you enter the shop before HQ
[*] The hens have a greeting phrase now (not just silence)[/list]
I hope the game is fine now.

Have a nice weekend!

notes.title: Some quality of life changes
notes.notes:
Thanks to everyone who has played Beautycopter so far!

I got some feedback, so here are the current patch notes:
[list][*] There's now a mini tutorial at the start!
[*] The Beautycopter drops slightly faster now
[*] No more auto-up when moving forward! 
[*] The simulator room at HQ now has a sign above the door
[*] Fixed the "I REALLY like to work here" achievement unlocking too early[/list]
Also, here's a fun video by a guy called Dootronator playing the game:

[previewyoutube=9ec5x9TVwaY;full][/previewyoutube]

I hope the update didn't break anything and if so, please don't hesitate to call me the in the middle of the night at this number: 0258256/332414023686352502. Have a nice day!
